**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target).**

- **Responsive clauses inspected:** § 23.4 grant (p0310), § 23.5 use restrictions (p0313), § 21.10 Affiliates (p0280), § 21.11 future acquisitions (p0282), § 22.4 Assignment (p0289), preamble definition of "Customer" (p0016), "Affiliate" definition (p0026), and the RDS/EFT licence references (p0120, p0125).
- **Affiliates:** already met — "Customer" is defined as Tri City National Bank "including its Affiliates", so the grant reaches affiliates without notice; no duplicate wording added.
- **Successor transfer:** fails fallback — the licence is expressly "non-transferable" and § 23.5 bars transfer/assignment to any third party; § 22.4 only permits assignment of the *Agreement*, and only on a $100,000,000 capital-and-surplus condition.
- **Cure:** two surgical replaces — successor-transfer permission in the grant, plus a conforming carve-out in the § 23.5 prohibition so no contradictory mechanic is retained. Preferred-level items (contractors, perpetual/irrevocable paid-up licence) noted but not pressed given the term-limited escrow structure.
